name: Ferryman
tagline: Every card in hand is a coin; the passenger you landed last is the one they can steal.
core_loop: On your turn ferry a Dock passenger by paying an equal-or-higher (or buoyant) hand card onto the shared Toll pile, or pay a card to poach the newest passenger off a player who is ahead of you, or wade a toll card or draw.
win_condition: Most points from the Shore ledger (per suit: highest card full, second half, rest 1 each), plus kin fares and suit majorities, minus one per card left in hand.
